title: Germany Funds Tens of Thousands of Quantum Systems Interceptor Drones for Ukraine
key_facts: Germany is paying for several tens of thousands of interceptor drones from Munich-based Quantum Systems for Ukraine
Chancellor Friedrich Merz announced it on a surprise visit to Kyiv; part of the winter 2026/2027 aid package
Drones will be produced in Ukraine; developed by Quantum WIY Industries; run on Quantum Systems' MOSAIC UXS software
Aimed at faster, jet-powered Shahed-type drones (up to about 230 mph)
Germany also pledged 1 billion euros for long-range weapons and 350 million euros for power plant repairs (per Euronews); over 40% of Germans say aid has gone too far
quote_evidence: Germany is paying for several tens of thousands of interceptor drones from the Munich-based defense tech unicorn Quantum Systems for Ukraine.
The drones are part of Germany's military aid package for the winter of 2026/2027 and will be produced directly in Ukraine.
why_it_matters_hint: Germany is financing mass production of drone interceptors inside Ukraine as Russia fields faster attack drones.
event_date: early Oct 2026 (Kyiv visit, date not stated)
notes: Single outlet (Trending Topics) with Euronews cited for other pledges; exact order size not given beyond 'several tens of thousands'.
